propositions: Repository-wide documentation and source comments require audit against operator standards for prose, punctuation, diction, formal voice, and audience fit.

Maintained prose surfaces include ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, developer comments, docstrings, schema descriptions, error text, and embedded narration across multiple file types.
Remediation proposals must be evidence-based, cite repository paths and implementation sources, classify by documentation type and audience, and specify target destination and action.
Generated artifacts, code syntax, licenses, quotations, and frozen output remain protected during remediation; only authored maintained prose undergoes review.
Foundation work (F01-F07) establishes documentation ownership policy, prose validation boundaries, comment guidance, and index checking before content-specific corrections land under epic REB-3501.
